target: force-platform initial-contact onset for each tracked foot
secondary_metrics: four-stage Macro F1 after frozen integration
candidate_training_sets: all development labels with synchronization-quality weighting

split_policy.development_validation: leave-one-subject-out; threshold selection inside each training fold

leakage_rules: Never train, tune, or select thresholds with test2.MOV or test3.MOV.
Never use Subj04 or Subj11 labels for v3 model selection.
Do not report visual-contact pseudo labels as force-contact F1.
Freeze preprocessing, model, and decoder before any new final test.
